Subject: Supplier onboarding: invoice submission channel & sample layout

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for starting the onboarding. Two quick questions before we submit our first invoice: 

1) Preferred channel: should we use the vendor portal or email invoices to ap@redwood.com? We currently send by SFTP/email.
2) Metadata: do you require a vendor ID, PO number placement, or remittance address in specific fields? Attached are examples of our current invoice PDF and CSV export.

Attachments:
- starlite_sample_invoice_001.pdf (pdf)
- starlite_invoice_export.csv (csv)

Thanks,

Sanjay Rao

sanjay.rao@starlite-tech.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding: invoice submission channel & sample layout

Hi Sanjay — welcome, and thanks for the samples. Short answer: portal preferred for production (faster processing + automatic PO matching). Email is allowed for one-off exceptions.

Requirements summary (for portal submissions):
- Field: PO Number (required) — place in header 'PO#' or the first line of the invoice.
- Vendor ID: optional but helpful — we'll create one during onboarding.
- Remittance address: free-text field in portal + structured line for our AP system.
- Line items: description, quantity, unit price, tax, line-level tax code (if applicable).

Exceptions via email:
- If you cannot access the portal, send to ap@redwood.com and include vendor tax ID and the PO number in the subject line.

I attached our lightweight sample template and a short checklist to make integration easier.

Next step: Ben will confirm PO stamping and any routing rules (we use PO stamping for invoices matched to committed POs). If all good, Marissa will schedule a test invoice on the portal.

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachments:
- redwood_invoice_template_minimal.xlsx
- onboarding_invoice_checklist.md

Thanks Karthik. Quick notes from AP:
- PO stamping: we require the PO number on the PDF body or filename. If invoice arrives without PO, it will route to exceptions with 10-business-day hold.
- For CSV/XML ingestion: map columns as follows — PO, Line#, Description, Qty, UnitPrice, TaxRate, Total. If you plan SFTP batches, we need a manifest file.
- Remittance: send remittance address in the 'Remit To' portal field. For email, include a single-line remittance address at the bottom.

Example filename convention we prefer: Redwood_PO123456_Starlite_INV0001.pdf

Ben
